description: Merged accounting inbox. mode='scan' recommends safe next steps; mode='dry_run' also runs safe dry-run steps.

bank_account_dimension_id.description: Optional default bank account dimension to reuse for CAMT and receipt suggestions.

mode.description: Workflow phase. scan plans; dry_run runs safe dry-run steps.

receipt_matching_dimension_id.description: Optional bank account dimension to use specifically for receipt matching suggestions.

wise_account_dimension_id.description: Optional bank account dimension to use specifically for Wise suggestions.

wise_inter_account_dimension_id.description: Optional own bank account dimension that Wise transfers go to and from (answers the wise_inter_account_dimension_id question; becomes the Wise step's inter_account_dimension_id). Ignored unless it is one of the other bank accounts.

workspace_path.description: Optional folder to scan. Defaults to the current workspace.

name: accounting_inbox
title: Accounting Inbox
